title: Adopt an existing repo ligma did not build
goal: You have a repo on your machine that this system has never seen. Bring it in, confirm the one thing it needs you to confirm about how it runs, and end up with a project that already knows what its users do and what it currently does. The project's own knowledge (.ligma/ — boot recipe, journeys, notes) belongs in the repo and will be written there on your confirm; what must NEVER be written into the repo is the system's record of current behaviour (characterization baselines) — that stays in the system's central store.
steps: Bring in a repository that already exists on this machine, from the home page — the design-tool checkout at /Users/alexraymond/ligma-classic is one such repo
Confirm how the app is run, once, rather than filling in a form about it
Let it explore the repo and propose the journeys its users take
Review what it proposes before any of it is written down
Find the project's Verify surface already populated with those journeys
Find the project's Knowledge surface already populated from the repo
Prove one of the proposed journeys from the Verify surface and wait for its run to finish, so the system records what the product currently does

Confirm from the project's Knowledge surface that the recorded behaviour baseline lives in the system's central store — and that the repo's own .ligma/ carries only the boot recipe, journeys and notes, not behaviour records
